description: This is an ornate, antique armchair upholstered in deep emerald green tufted leather. The frame of the chair features intricate carvings and is finished in a dark, aged wood with metallic accents. The button-tufted backrest and seat create a classic, regal appearance, while the rolled arms and curved legs add to its vintage charm. The leather shows signs of wear, suggesting a rich history and a sense of luxury. This chair would be a statement piece in any room, exuding elegance and sophistication.
